liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (5 reviews, 1 other source): Played with a slide show, and a shooting star crossed the sky overhead; Stays on the main theme and never develops into a real jam [4][24][27][31][33][34]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (4 reviews): A giant beachball dropped in front of Jerry during the build-up; The Scarlet>Touch>Fire sequence is played extremely fast, with Jerry on fire [24][28][31][33]
- **The Wheel** (2 reviews): Jerry's transition out of Space into the song has odd electronic buzzing and careful playing; very short and melting; Played with trippy urgency in a second set full of funky jamming [27][30]
- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): A huge soap bubble floated above Jerry's head during the closing section; Described as plaintive, showing Garcia both vulnerable and powerful [24][30]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Roaring opening notes raised hopes, but the band was loose for the rest of set one [29]

## Setlist highlights

- **Dark Star**: back after 176 archived shows (925 days) [36]

## The recordings

- **gd84-07-13.sbd.ferguson.353.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4.53/5 by 60 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound excellent; Reviewer calls the recording's sound nice [29][31]
- **gd1984-07-13.150404.sbd.anon.gems.2444**: soundboard; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1984-07-13.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.96153.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4.08/5 by 13 [5]. Said about its sound: The set 2 disc change is seamless [5]
- **gd1984-07-13.sbd.ferguson.joshd.fix-353.90464.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 155 min; rated 3.5/5 by 10 [6]

## Around the show

- In a Middletown NY line, people who missed the show called Dark Star lame; the tape changed their minds [32]
- A Friday the 13th with a full moon, supposedly first such coincidence in 200 years [35]
- The Democratic convention, a Moral Majority convention and a hookers convention were all in town [35]
- A man in line said Phil had seen the setlist and was excited; his laminate got him inside [35]
- Full moon on Friday the 13th, with a shooting star over the stage at the start of Dark Star [4]
- Reviewer calls it probably the best of the three shows in this run [27]
- Dark Star encore is possibly the reviewer's favorite from after the band's Dark Star hiatus [28]
- Much better than the other Greek shows in that year's run [29]
- One of the better shows of a year with surprisingly good music [33]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd84-07-13.sbd.ferguson.353.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > ? > CDR> DAE (cdparanoia)> SHN [1]. Also: Reviewer first knew this show from an audience tape; Soundboard through an unknown source to CDR, extracted with cdparanoia to SHN by Mark Ferguson; hiss suggests an analog generation [1][34]
- **gd1984-07-13.150404.sbd.anon.gems.2444**: taped by ANON; transferred by Speed Corrections by Jason Chastain Mastering by Jim Blackwood and Jamie Waddell; source: Soundboard Cassette Masters Sony D-6 [4]. Also: The Betamania source has a few spots patched for tape flips and pauses [4]
- **gd1984-07-13.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.96153.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D6/Maxell XLII-S90/TDK MA90) [5]. Also: Bertha and Greatest Story Ever Told are patched in from a first-generation cassette; tapes from Joani Walker and Paul Scotton [5]
- **gd1984-07-13.sbd.ferguson.joshd.fix-353.90464.flac16**: transferred by Speed Correction by joshd; source: SBD > ? > CDR [6]. Also: Speed was corrected in Cool Edit Pro, lowering most of the show by 23 cents, tuned against A=440; The encore's pitch differs from the rest and the same correction doesn't bring it in tune [6]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by gratefuldeadshirt.org: [Grateful Dead Shirt T Shirt Vintage 1984 Greek Theatre UC Berkeley Cal CA GDP L | Grateful Dead Shirt](https://gratefuldeadshirt.org/grateful-dead-shirt-t-shirt-vintage-1984-greek-theatre-uc-berkeley-cal-ca-gdp-l/) [37]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1984-07-13 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1984-07-13-backstage-pass/) [38]
- Poster by Steven Rood Grateful Dead: [1984-07-15 Greek Theatre, Berkeley, CA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-07-15-greek-theatre-berkeley-ca/) [39]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Greek Theatre - July 13, 1984](https://www.dead.net/show/july-13-1984) [40]

claims.text: A giant beachball dropped in front of Jerry during the build-up
A huge soap bubble floated above Jerry's head during the closing section
Played with a slide show, and a shooting star crossed the sky overhead
Jerry's transition out of Space into the song has odd electronic buzzing and careful playing; very short and melting
Stays on the main theme and never develops into a real jam
Reviewer calls it probably the best of the three shows in this run
The Scarlet>Touch>Fire sequence is played extremely fast, with Jerry on fire
Dark Star encore is possibly the reviewer's favorite from after the band's Dark Star hiatus
Reviewer finds the sound excellent
Roaring opening notes raised hopes, but the band was loose for the rest of set one
Much better than the other Greek shows in that year's run
Played with trippy urgency in a second set full of funky jamming
Described as plaintive, showing Garcia both vulnerable and powerful
Scarlet>Touch>Fire is fast and outrageous for the period
Unexplorative but with a nice groove throughout
Reviewer calls the recording's sound nice
In a Middletown NY line, people who missed the show called Dark Star lame; the tape changed their minds
Scarlet>Touch>Fire is cool and high-energy
A more-than-respectable effort given the circumstances
One of the better shows of a year with surprisingly good music
Not explorative, but the interplay among all band members is exceptional
Reviewer first knew this show from an audience tape
A Friday the 13th with a full moon, supposedly first such coincidence in 200 years
The Democratic convention, a Moral Majority convention and a hookers convention were all in town
A man in line said Phil had seen the setlist and was excited; his laminate got him inside
Soundboard through an unknown source to CDR, extracted with cdparanoia to SHN by Mark Ferguson; hiss suggests an analog generation
First Dark Star since 12/31/1981, 167 shows earlier; the next came at the 10/9/1989 Warlocks show
Full moon on Friday the 13th, with a shooting star over the stage at the start of Dark Star
The Betamania source has a few spots patched for tape flips and pauses
Bertha and Greatest Story Ever Told are patched in from a first-generation cassette; tapes from Joani Walker and Paul Scotton
The set 2 disc change is seamless
Speed was corrected in Cool Edit Pro, lowering most of the show by 23 cents, tuned against A=440
The encore's pitch differs from the rest and the same correction doesn't bring it in tune
